title: Admission result
description: Issued only by HQ in reply to Hello. Source: draft 0.4, Section 5 and Appendix A. Carries no secrets; channel bindings are opaque, broker-generated references to protected connections.

installation_epoch.description: Authoritative current epoch; the commit fence (Section 5).

profile.description: Profile actually in force. Never silently weaker than requested without this field saying so.

channel_binding.description: Opaque reference to the protected channel HQ bound this runtime to; not a bearer token.

app_id.description: Client app identifier, lowercase kebab-case. The schema names no vendor; fixtures use neutral ids (R10).

profile.description: Profile or instance of the client app on this device, when the app has more than one.

source.description: How HQ identified the client, strongest first: adapter = reported over ACP; process = derived by HQ from the connecting process (peer credentials, then the executable's code-signing identity); owner-label = assigned by the owner at first enrollment.

client.description: HQ's identification of the client app or profile. A session is the device (the installation) plus this client. Omitted when HQ has none yet; recorded on the admission receipt. Decision C20.

lease_generation.description: First lease generation for the admitted runtimes; Ready and lease renewal carry it forward, and a changed lead gets a new one (Section 7, T07).

warnings.description: E.g. a role whose adapter is unevaluated on this harness version (Section 10).
